The '''Poressi system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] ''[[Leveler]]'' accidentally traveled to the Poressi system, due to a fault with its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].
